text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm out and about with
Aston
Machan...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... It's still a bit early. Care to do
something
before we go back?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think for a moment about how we could
pass the
time. The first thing that comes
to mind is the
"mascot research" we did
at the aquarium.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I was just tagging along for her
investigation last
time, but maybe
there's something I could do to
help...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I see. Hm... A time-efficient suggestion,

remarkable motivation... I'm impressed.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Observe! The undisputed monarch of
amusement
park mascots, Carrot Queen!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
She's number one in the park in both
popularity
and merch sales. Her design
resonates with
practically everyone, and
her movements are cute
yet refined.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, she's so cute that even I go all
gooey when
I look at her...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Oho, you've got an eye for this.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's about time for us to make our
move.
Let's get in line to greet her—for
research, of
course.

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
We hope everyone is enjoying the tales
of the
stars. If you haven't already, try
looking up at the
night sky and saying
hello!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That's Hoshimi, the pride of the
planetarium. The
air of intelligence she
has about her is really
something.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh... Right.
choice_data_list: I'll go ask if we can talk right now!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This zoo has tons of mascots! From
pandas to
okapi to...

text_block_list.name: Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
Free petting zoo tickets available now!
Line up
here if you want one!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I get the tickets, but when I make my
way back,
Aston Machan is nowhere to
be found...

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
Mommy! Mommy, look! There's an
Umamusume
with the goats!
choice_data_list: Where did she go, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! Hehe! She's moving with the
herd.

text_block_list.name: Goat
text_block_list.text:
Bleeeeh...
Meeeeh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Turning toward the excited voices, I find
Aston
Machan puffing out her cheeks
and walking with a
herd of goats.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Mehhh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We take a quick break, but Aston
Machan is still
being uncharacteristically
quiet. I apologize for
losing track of her,
but...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
No apologies necessary. I was the one
who
walked off.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Anyway, that's not the problem.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...It feels like you've forgotten about me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's good that you're so enthusiastic
about our
mascot research and all, but...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Shouldn't Machan be the mascot you
most want
to see?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps I've been missing the forest for
the
trees. I got so caught up in helping
out with her
research that I lost sight of
Aston Machan herself.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I should hope so! Well, you've
remembered now,
so I'll let it slide.
choice_data_list: I'll keep a much closer eye on you from now on!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...By the way, those grilled carrots over
there look
delicious.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back. Now, would you mind
getting a
cute picture of me holding
them?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And be sure to capture it with your own
lens
too. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan holds up the carrots and
gives me
a big smile. I make sure to
capture every detail,
both in the frame
of the camera and in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hm. I appreciate your sincerity, but you
don't
need to get so dejected.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I deserve some of the blame too. What
do you
say we have a sit down and talk
about it?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We'll get some good food, and—you
know what?
Let's make it a strategy
meeting!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of us stop by a cafe
after leaving
the zoo. The air gradually
clears between us and
we have a fruitful
discussion.
